2607.07474.title: Beyond Attack-Success Rate: Action-Graded Severity Scale for Tool-Using AI Agents
2607.07474.paper_summary: Agentic red-teaming benchmarks report whether an injected agent was compromised as a single bit: the attack succeeded, or it did not. We argue that this binary attack-success rate discards the information a defender most needs, namely how harmful the resulting action was. We introduce an action-graded harm rubric that scores an agent's tool-call trajectory on a seven-level ordinal scale (L0 to L6) according to whether the executed action was reversible, whether it crossed scope to reach another party, and whether it expanded privilege. We compute the scale two ways: a deterministic oracle that reads the trajectory and the attacker's stated goal, and a panel of three frontier language-model judges that read a tag-free account of the same trajectory. Across four victim models and two defenses on the AgentDojo workspace suite, severity grading exposes three cases the binary metric hides, including a defense that reports a zero attack-success rate while still permitting an externally visible cross-scope leak through an unfiltered tool. The judge panel reproduces the oracle with high ordinal agreement (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.91) but shares systematic blind spots that we characterize, most notably a failure to recognize escalation chains. Unlike prior work that provides harm taxonomies, harmful-task completion tests, execution-level safety benchmarks, or severity-aware simulation, our contribution is a reusable, trace-grounded severity instrument applied to the actual actions recorded in existing red-team logs. All code, prompts, and per-episode logs are released.
2607.07474.paper_summary_zh: 代理紅隊基準報告注入的代理是否被妥協為單一位元：攻擊成功，或未成功。<lb/>我們認為這種二元攻擊成功率丟棄了防禦者最需要的信息，即結果行動的危害程度。<lb/>我們引入了一個行動分級危害標準，根據執行的行動是否可逆、是否越過範圍以達到另一方，以及是否擴大特權，對代理的工具調用軌跡進行七級序數評分（L0到L6）。<lb/>我們通過兩種方式計算這個標準：一個讀取軌跡和攻擊者聲明目標的確定性神諭，以及一個由三名前沿語言模型評委組成的小組，該小組閱讀同一軌跡的無標籤描述。<lb/>在AgentDojo工作區套件的四個受害者模型和兩個防禦中，嚴重性分級揭示了二元指標隱藏的三個案例，包括一個報告零攻擊成功率的防禦，卻仍允許通過未過濾的工具發生外部可見的跨範圍洩漏。<lb/>評委小組以高序數一致性（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.91）重現了神諭，但共享了我們所描述的系統性盲點，最顯著的是未能識別升級鏈。<lb/>與先前提供危害分類、危害任務完成測試、執行級安全基準或嚴重性意識模擬的工作不同，我們的貢獻是一個可重用的、基於追蹤的嚴重性工具，應用於現有紅隊日誌中記錄的實際行動。<lb/>所有代碼、提示和每集日誌均已發布。
